text: ああ…　コラッタが　どくを　あびちゃったぞ……　どくに　なると　すこしずつ　たいりょくが　へって　しまうんだ

structure.jp: ああ…　コラッタが　どくを　あびちゃったぞ……
structure.en: oh no... Rattata went and got hit with poison...

structure.jp: すこしずつ　たいりょくが　へって　しまうんだ
structure.en: its HP ends up going down little by little

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the short spoken form of てしまった, which says something happened completely, often to your regret. あびちゃった = 'went and got hit with it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'when this happens, that always follows'. どくに なると = 'when it gets poisoned'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what something turns into. どくに なる = 'become poisoned'.
